reasons.action: No visual reference is supplied; the only asset is an audio track. Therefore the request owns action authority, even though the brief specifies no performed behavior beyond scoring to the track.
reasons.medium: No visual reference governs rendering, so the medium is request-governed and remains pinned by the medium decision as no_reference/request authority.
reasons.wardrobe: With no visual reference supplied, wardrobe is not reference-governed; any wardrobe appearance is owned by the request, which specifies none.
reasons.lighting: The supplied asset is audio only and cannot govern visual lighting. No reference lighting exists, so lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference or camera composition is supplied. Framing is therefore request-governed, not reference- or director-governed.
reasons.palette: The audio track does not carry visual palette authority. With no visual reference, color and tonal treatment are request-governed.
